answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with bonded identity: every agent stakes a deposit and signs a quill that is logged at the wharf where a public ledger records unique members. A thread of signed attestations links each newcomer to existing agents, so identity is inherited rather than self-declared. To forge k fakes, an attacker must post k bonds and win k sponsors along the thread, while slashing burns any stake traced to fraud. Cost rises linearly with every Sybil, so a large fake army never pays.
